literal: From meanness freed sweet word, in the next birth too, in this birth too, happiness will give.
translation: Sweet words freed from all meanness will bring happiness in this birth and the next.
modern: குற்றமற்ற இனிய சொற்கள் ஒருவனுக்கு இந்தப் பிறவியிலும் அடுத்த பிறவியிலும் இன்பத்தைத் தரும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the enduring power of speaking kindly and without malice. The phrase 'சிறுமையுவு நீங்கிய' emphasizes that true sweet words must be free from deceit, harm, or petty intentions. When a person speaks such pure and pleasant words, it yields joy and good outcomes not only in their current life but also in the life to come.
